text:
alisha_solutions: Quick sync — Sapphire (customer) wants to onboard their custom 13B variant for a POC. They asked for q4_kv quant + prefix caching + KMS in eu-west-1. Can eng confirm variant compatibility and any blockers? CC @matt_research @inga_eng @jordan_cse

matt_research: Do we have the tokenizer mapping and model config? Sapphire uses a nonstandard tokenizer with some merged tokens; need to validate token id mapping before KV cache assumptions.

inga_eng: I pulled the model spec they sent. Tokenizer looks like a small detokenizer tweak but should be fine. Main risk is memory layout with q4_kv for 13B + 512 token seqs — we'll need a KV layout check and a perf run. Also need to know expected p95 SLO and burst profile.

sarah_sales: Customer target: 40 rps peak, avg prompt+resp ~512 tokens, p95 < 350ms. Also pricing question: how much does q4_kv change unit cost vs fp16? They're comparing hosted vs dedicated.

jordan_cse: Security: they require KMS in eu-west-1, FIPS-140 flag on crypto, and a few items on the questionnaire about key rotation and audit logs. If FIPS is required we usually recommend Private or Dedicated with HSM.

security-bot: Flagged: FIPS-140 requirement -> recommend Private deployment or Dedicated with validated KMS/HSM. Add ticket SEC-2026 for questionnaire answers.

deploy-bot: Note: last dedicated run for similar config (13B q4_kv) shows p95 210ms @32 rps on g5dn-like hardware with prefix caching enabled.

alisha_solutions: Helpful — can eng produce a short checklist (yes/no) we can send the customer? Also need an estimate for monthly cost at 40 rps for both hosted (with quant) and dedicated reserved.

matt_research: Checklist (short): 1) Tokenizer mapping validated (attach sample) 2) KV-quant memory layout check OK 3) Perf run with q4_kv @512 tokens -> p95 within SLO 4) KMS region + FIPS confirmed 5) Rollout plan: canary variant -> 100% with automatic fallback to fp16 variant. Pricing note: q4_kv ~0.55–0.7x CPU/GPU token cost vs fp16 depending on kernel efficiency.

inga_eng: I'll run the KV layout + perf tomorrow, attaching quick command for perf harness:

```
./perf_runner --model ./sapphire-13b --quant q4_kv --batch 8 --seq 512 --rps 40 --cache prefix
```

I'll post results in here when done.

sarah_sales: Perfect, once we have the checklist and a rough cost delta I can update the quote and the security questionnaire reply.

alisha_solutions: Thanks — adding action owners: @inga_eng perf + layout; @matt_research tokenizer mapping; @jordan_cse security answers. I'll ping legal on the KMS/HSM terms. :thumbsup:
